name: the wordmark glows alone in the dark as the camera pulls back
looks: The brand's wordmark glows softly in the centre of an otherwise pitch-black frame. The camera slowly pulls back, so the glowing type shrinks and dims into the distance, growing smaller and quieter as the shot holds.
build: A single bloom sprite/text layer pinned to the wordmark, pulsing gently; the camera (or a scale tween on the whole layer) eases the wordmark from large to small over the shot's length on a slow, linear-to-eased pull, paired with a `grain-vignette.md` pass so the black field never reads flat.
sound: A low pad and room tone, fading further as the pull-back continues, with no hits.
prompt: Close on the name glowing alone in total darkness, then pull the camera slowly back so it shrinks into the distance and the glow dims with it, ending on a small, quiet point of light in a black frame.
